reviews.title: NOT HAPPY w/ the CONSTANT requests for a rating.
reviews.text:
:::NEW UPDATE::: 8/20/26
Upon further review, this app is awful.
Even forgetting the extremely annoying “RATE US PLEASE!” Pop ups that would not stop until I entered a review and the many times I was completely unable to access the app. There was also the fact that everything I entered kept disappearing.
I’d make an entry and the next time I opened the app, everything I had entered before was gone.
Like magic… but uncool, frustrating and irritating.
Also, the app on general is not really customizable. Instead it’s extremely limited. And where it’s limited is where you NEED to have the most options and freedom to customize… which is where you “choose” your mood.
There are ONLY EIGHT MOOD CHOICES:
Happy, Angry, Loved, Frustrated, Goofy, Surprised, Annoyed and Funny.  That is ALL.
NO other options for your mood. NONE.😶

SERIOUSLY!!?? 😒🤦🏻‍♀️

Is “surprised” even an actual mood??

Soooo….. with the immediate harassment for a review, the frequency in which the app won’t even open, the disappearance of all entries after closing the app and the horrible, lame, ridiculous “options” for entries and absolutely ZERO option to select from more than just EIGHT PRESET MOODS, or ability to customize those mood “choices”….
THIS APP IS THE WORST!
Do NOT DOWNLOAD this app. Don’t waste your precious time.
There are literally HUNDREDS of other mood/anxiety apps in the App Store. Go download one of those. Anything but this app. 
A kindergartener could create a much better app.


::Update:: 8/15/26
I can’t even open the app now. I clicked a reminder notification and was met with a spinning “waiting” circle. I waited a few minutes, then closed and restarted the app.
SAME THING…. Spinning, spinning, nothing but spinning.
I’m taking a star back; I’d take 2 away, but the minimum is☝🏽⭐️ 🙄
I’ll continue to check bad periodically and see if the spinning stops and I am able to access the app.
Then hopefully I can actually use it and give real review. 
Hopefully the annoying “RATE ME!!” Pop ups are gone.

COME ON DEVS… make it work please!

I keep getting super ANNOYING POP UPS for a damn rating! I just barely installed the app and started using it. The pop ups started before I even finished set-up.
GEEEEZ!
 So my loooow rating is because of that.

I MIGHT change my rating of the pop ups STOP… FOR GOOD!
The ONLY reason I gave 2 ⭐️ right now is because in spite of the super ANNOYING pop ups, it seems like a great app.
But we shall see.
I want an apology from the Devs for the harassment to give a damn review.
Then I’ll keep using the app and give a FAIR & HONEST review. 
I believe this app has potential, I just need to be left alone while I use it.

YOU are giving me ANXIETY DEVS 🤦🏻‍♀️
